data.one_liner: Set display mode, resolution, and refresh rate on Android platform.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to set the display mode on the Android platform. It allows developers to enable high refresh rates on supported Android devices.
use_when: You need to enable high refresh rates on Android devices with discrete framerates.
You want to programmatically set preferred display modes or use high/low refresh rate helpers.
avoid_when: Targeting iOS devices or devices with LTPO panels where this library is ineffective.
You don't need low-level display mode configuration on Android.
strengths: Easy helper methods like setHighRefreshRate and setLowRefreshRate.
Supports fetching active, preferred, and supported display modes.
weaknesses: Ineffective on iOS devices with ProMotion and devices with LTPO panels.
Dependent on the system honoring preferred modes.
data.setup_notes: Add library to pubspec and rebuild app.
